item.title: Sentosa beach club Tipsy Unicorn closes after High Court winds up operator Tipsy Bird
item.description: Sentosa’s nightlife circuit has lost one of its flashiest players. Tipsy Unicorn has ceased operations after the High Court ordered its operator, Tipsy Bird, to be wound up. According to reports, the court placed Tipsy Bird into compulsory liquidation following a winding-up application filed by United Overseas Bank (UOB) over outstanding debts. item.title: World’s #1 Michael Jackson tribute show 'This Is Michael' lands in Singapore this June

Presented by Row One, the globally acclaimed show has sold over 500,000 tickets worldwide and toured more than 25 countries, bringing MJ’s biggest hits to arenas and festivals across Europe and Latin America. item.title: BLACKPINK become first artist in history to surpass 100 million YouTube subscribers
item.description: Ahead of their upcoming comeback, BLACKPINK have officially become the first artist in the world to surpass 100 million subscribers on YouTube — cementing their reign as the undisputed “Queens of YouTube.” According to YG Entertainment, the group’s official channel crossed the 100 million mark roughly 9 years and 8 months after it launched on 28 June 2016.
